item.title: Superstar producer Teddy Riley talks new memoir, headlining Zulu Ball
item.description: He stopped by the WGNO-TV studios to share information about his new memoir and to tell us what to expect at his Zulu Ball performance.

item.title: Governor's Office of Victim's Advocacy announces release of requests for proposals for memorial to honor Jan. 1 terrorist attack victims
item.description: The Governor's Office of Victim's Advocacy announced the release of a request for proposals for a permanent memorial to be placed in New Orleans, commemorating the victims of the Jan. 1 terrorist attack.

item.title: Two killed in separate Lafourche Parish crashes
item.description: Troopers with the Louisiana State Police are investigating two separate fatal crashes in Lafourche Parish that happened on Thursday, Feb. 12.

item.title: Former St. Bernard pastor sentenced for indecent behavior with juveniles case
item.description: A former Chalmette pastor was sentenced to the maximum prison time of seven years for indecent behavior with juveniles on Wednesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: Two-alarm fire destroys New Orleans East home
item.description: A New Orleans East home is destroyed after a fire on Thursday night, Feb. 12.

item.title: 43-year-old Lafourche Parish woman arrested, accused of defrauding more than $98,000 from Medicaid
item.description: The Louisiana Bureau of Investigation arrested a Gheens woman accused of defrauding the Medicaid program of more than $98,000.

item.title: Dillard University hosts a day-long Black History program
item.description: In our tribute to black history, Dillard University hosted a full day of programs to prepare students for what they may face as they earn their degree.

item.title: Patrick Warburton visits Children's Hospital in annual Bacchus visit
item.description: The annual Bacchus visit to Children's Hospital happened Friday, Feb. 13, with Patrick Warburton spending time with some of the young patients and family members.

item.title: New Orleans police investigate fatal Lower Garden District shooting
item.description: Officers with the New Orleans Police Department are investigating a shooting that left a man dead in the Lower Garden District on Friday, Feb. 13.
